raw_market.description: In the upcoming NFL football game between Saints and Giants, scheduled for October 18 at 1:00 PM ET: This market will resolve to "Over" if Isaiah Likely records more than 59.5 receiving yards in this game, and to "Under" if Isaiah Likely records 59.5 or fewer receiving yards. Stat corrections issued after the game has been completed will not count. If the player is inactive or does not play, this market will resolve to "Under". If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
